defect: a flop has an asynchronous set from one clock domain and reset from another
rationale: event_b_q is generated in clk_b_i and drives an asynchronous set on a clk_a_i flop, while reset_a_ni is an unrelated asynchronous reset.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

mutation.description: Added a clock-b-domain signal to the asynchronous set event control of a clock-a-domain register.

labels.note: A remote-domain event asynchronously sets a destination flop; release is not synchronized to the destination, and the raw reset also releases directly.
